enumDefs.name: sourcelume_record_status
enumDefs.description: Curation state of a Sourcelume record: PENDING (submitted, awaiting validation), INCOMPLETE (validation failed, curatable), ACTIVE (validated and published). This is a Sourcelume domain state, independent of the backend's existence lifecycle (Atlas ACTIVE/DELETED/PURGED). qualifiedName is inherited from Referenceable via DataSet and intentionally not redeclared.

entityDefs.name: sourcelume_dataset
entityDefs.description: Entity for a dataset tracked by Sourcelume, carrying the ingest lifecycle attributes plus the provenance attributes used by the ingest pipeline. The full sourcelume-spec attribute set follows as the spec evolves.
